One thing I look for in a prop firm is whether the rules make sense for the trader.

Because passing an evaluation is one thing.

Trading within the rules, managing risk, and actually getting paid is another.

That’s why I’ve been promoting @FTMarketslive (FundedTrader Markets).

If you’re considering a prop firm, don’t just look at the account size or discount.

Read the rules. Understand the payout conditions. Know what you’re signing up for.

The goal isn’t just to get funded. It’s to find a firm whose rules and conditions you understand before you put your money on the line.

Your first win doesn’t have to be your biggest win. Sometimes, it just needs to prove that it’s POSSIBLE📌

I still have the certificate from my very first prop firm challenge. I passed both phases, got funded, but never made it to payout.

Yet, I was incredibly proud of myself because that experience proved I could do it again, and possibly do even better.

So I kept going.

Today, I’ve passed over $1 million worth of prop firm challenges cumulatively, across different accounts over the years.

Looking back, that first achievement gave me something more valuable than money at the time, BELIEF.

And this goes beyond trading.

If you’ve achieved something before and lost it, don’t let your current struggles make you doubt your capabilities.

You may have to start again, but you’re not starting from zero.

One difficult season doesn’t erase everything you’ve accomplished💅
